text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Perkhidmatan Kewangan
(Amaun Minimum Dana Modal atau Lebihan Aset berbanding Liabiliti ) (Orang
Berlesen) 2013.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 30 Jun 2013.

Pemakaian

2. Perintah ini terpakai bagi orang berlesen.

Tafsiran

3. Dalam Perintah ini—

 "bank asing yang diperbadankan di Malaysia" ertinya bank berlesen—

(a) yang merupakan subsidiari kepada syarikat asing; atau

(b) yang mana satu atau lebih orang asing memiliki, secara agregat, lebih
daripada separuh hak mengundi atau modal syer terbitan dalam bank
berlesen itu;

"penanggung insurans semula profesional am berlesen" ertinya seorang penanggung
insurans semula yang dipe rbadankan di Malaysia yang dilesenkan di bawah seksyen 10
Akta untuk menjalankan perniagaan insurans semula am semata-mata;

 "penanggung insurans semula professional asing berlesen" ertinya seorang
penanggung insurans semula yang diperbadankan di luar Mal aysia yang dilesenkan di
bawah seksyen 10 Akta untuk menjalankan perniagaan insurans semula semata-mata;

 "penanggung insurans semula profesional hayat berlesen" ertinya seorang
penanggung insurans semula yang diperbadankan di Malaysia yang dilesenkan di  bawah
seksyen 10 Akta untuk menjalankan perniagaan insurans semula hayat semata-mata.

Dana modal minimum

4. Amaun minimum dana modal bagi orang berlesen hendaklah mengikut amaun yang
ditentukan dalam Jadual.

Lebihan aset berbanding liabiliti minimum

5. Amaun minimum lebihan aset berbanding liabiliti bagi penanggung insurans semula
professional asing berlesen adalah sebanyak dua puluh juta ringgit.

FINANCIAL SERVICES ACT 2013

FINANCIAL SERVICES (MINIMUM AMOUNT OF CAPITAL FUNDS OR SURPLUS OF ASSETS
OVER LIABILITIES) (LICENSED PERSON) ORDER 2013

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 12(1)  of the Financial Services Act 2013
[Act 758], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) This order may be cited as the Financial Services (Minimum Amount of
Capital Funds or Surplus of Assets over Liabilities) (Licensed Person) Order 2013.

 (2) This Order comes into operation on 30 June 2013.

Application
2. This Order applies to a licensed person.

Interpretation
3. In this Order—

"locally incorporated foreign bank" means a licensed bank—

(a) which is a subsidiary of a foreign company; or

(b) where one or more foreign persons own, in aggregate, more than half
of the voting rights in or issued share capital of that licensed bank;

 "licensed general professional reinsurer" means a reinsurer incorporated in
Malaysia which is licensed under section 10 of the Act to carry on solely general
reinsurance business;

"licensed foreign professional reinsurer" means a reinsurer incorporated outside
Malaysia which is licensed under section 10 of the Act to carry on solely reinsurance
business;

 "licensed life professional reinsurer" means a reinsurer incorporated in Malaysia
which is licensed under section 10 of the Act to carry on solely life reinsurance business.

 Minimum capital funds
4. The minimum amount of capital funds of a licensed person shall be in accordance
with the amount specified in the Schedule.

Minimum surplus of assets over liabilities
5. The minimum amount of surplus of assets over liabilities of a licensed foreign
professional reinsurer shall be twenty million ringgit.
